mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_battle_group_tombstone (station_id, group_name, name_norm, group_id, slot_no, source, created_by) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{groupName}, #{nameNorm}, #{groupId}, #{slotNo}, #{source}, #{createdBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE released_at = NULL, released_by = NULL, group_id = VALUES(group_id), slot_no = VALUES(slot_no), source = VALUES(source), gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ccds_battle_group_tombstone WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND released_at IS NULL ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ccds_battle_group_tombstone SET released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, released_by = #{releasedBy}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND name_norm = #{nameNorm} AND released_at IS NULL
